instruction: Capture a screenshot from the currently playing video and save it to your Pictures folder

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires taking a video snapshot in VLC and saving it to Pictures folder. Default VLC snapshot location is /home/user/Pictures/ with filename pattern vlc-snap*.png. Evaluator uses glob pattern to find any vlc-snap*.png files, validates they are valid PNG images with non-zero size (>1KB), and checks file modification timestamp to ensure the snapshot was created recently (within 5 minutes) to distinguish from pre-existing files.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic verification is comprehensive and correct: evaluator can definitively verify that a VLC snapshot was successfully captured and saved
Complete coverage of instruction requirements: checks file existence in Pictures folder, validates PNG format, ensures meaningful content (>1KB), and verifies recency
Getter logic correctly extracts all needed state: uses glob pattern to find vlc-snap*.png files, validates format with 'file' command, checks size, and validates timestamp
Metric comparison logic is sound: properly validates all conditions (existence, recency, size >=1KB) and handles dict return type correctly
Robust edge case handling: handles missing files, invalid/corrupted PNGs, pre-existing snapshots (via recency check), and multiple snapshot files
Clock skew issue properly addressed: uses VM time ('date +%s') for consistent time source between current time and file mtime
Data flow is correct: getter extracts {exists, file_path, file_size, is_recent} → metric validates all aspects → expected value is semantically correct
No postconfig needed: file persists to disk after task completion without requiring UI interaction

changes: Updated getter to use glob pattern (find command) to search for any vlc-snap*.png files instead of checking exact path
Added file modification timestamp validation to ensure file was created recently (within 5 minutes)
Added content validation: verifies file size > 1KB to ensure meaningful content
Added PNG format validation using 'file' command to verify it's a valid PNG image
Changed getter return type from boolean to dict with detailed info (exists, file_path, file_size, is_recent)
Updated metric to validate all conditions: existence, recency, and valid size
CRITICAL FIX: Replaced time.time() with VM time using 'date +%s' command to avoid clock skew between host and VM
